name: AnimeClick Metadata
description: Provider metadati anime in italiano basato su AnimeClick.it con scraping etico e cache locale.
overview: Fornisce titoli, trame, generi, valutazioni e cover art in italiano per anime, utilizzando AnimeClick.it come fonte.

versions.changelog: v0.2.1: Fix titoli Special/OVA/OAD assegnati erroneamente a stagioni regolari. Parser rileva episodi Special dal titolo e forza SeasonNumber=0. EpisodeMatcher blocca fallback absolute per titoli Special su richieste di stagione regolare. EpisodeProvider safety net per ParentIndexNumber > 0. Nuovo regex SpecialTitleRegex per pattern Special/OVA/OAV/OAD/ONA/PV/Recap/Bonus/Extra.

v0.2.0: Matching episodi universale con normalizzazione AnimeClick per numero assoluto, progressivo stagione e ID episodio. Diagnostica admin per lookup, preview episodi e pulizia cache mirata. Ricerca migliorata con scoring per titolo, anno e tipo. Cache episodi/season-map versionata. OP/ED best-effort con warning per pagine trailer/PV-only.
v0.1.2: Fix metadati multi-stagione. Parsing S{N} Ep.{M} per stagioni sulla stessa pagina. Risoluzione stagioni su pagine separate via relazioni AnimeClick. Nuovo SeasonProvider. Filtro spin-off.
v0.1.1: Allineamento versione con KometaThemes.

name: KometaThemes
description: KometaThemes automatically downloads anime theme songs (OPs and EDs) from animethemes.moe. Features multi-season detection, AllPerSeason fetch, multi-provider resolution, parallel downloads, global playlist generation, REST API, and bilingual Italian/English UI.
overview: Download anime OP/ED from animethemes.moe with multi-provider, multi-season, and playlist support.

versions.changelog: v2.7.0.4: Workaround for Jellyfin 10.11.11 ThemeSong CollectionFolder bug. After downloading, copies best theme to theme.mp3 in series root — the oldest and most reliable Jellyfin theme convention. theme-music/ and backdrops/ files are kept for future compatibility. A Force Sync is needed after upgrade.

v2.7.0.3: ForceSync now triggers FullRefresh even when no themes change. In 2.7.0.2, RefreshMetadata only ran on new downloads; ForceSync with existing files skipped the download entirely, leaving themes linked to CollectionFolder. A Force Sync is required to reassign existing theme items to Series parents.

v2.7.0.2: Fix themes not playing on Jellyfin 10.11.x — RefreshMetadata now uses MetadataRefreshMode.FullRefresh to force ThemeMediaResolver to assign theme songs to the correct Series parent instead of CollectionFolder. IsSatisfied now falls back to filesystem check when GetThemeSongs() is empty. Root cause: Jellyfin 10.11.11's ThemeMediaResolver links theme items to library root during default refresh. A Force Sync is needed to re-trigger metadata refresh for existing items.

v2.7.0.1: Critical hotfix — circular DI dependency between LibrarySyncHandler and ItemRemovedHandler caused plugin to fail to load with Malfunctioned on Jellyfin 10.11.x. Removed unused LibrarySyncHandler field from ItemRemovedHandler. Plugin now loads cleanly. Bumped version badges in all HTML pages.

v2.7.0.0: Health endpoint exposing version, cache stats, sync state and download metrics. ItemRemoved handler with opt-in cleanup toggle (theme-music/, backdrops/, _kometa_themes.json). Theme Finder now respects user-configured audio/video volume. New Automation tab with AutoSyncOnItemAdded, CleanupThemesOnItemRemoved, NotifyOnSyncComplete. M3U playlist export endpoint. Per-item preview/dry-run endpoint. Last sync summary surfaced in config UI. Reset to Defaults button. Live input validation. DownloadMetrics counters. xUnit test project with 18 tests. GitHub Actions CI workflow. Fixes: DownloadTracker now wired in (was dead code), orphan pruning only touches files we wrote, RateLimitingHandler hot-reloads on config change, LibrarySyncHandler has SemaphoreSlim(2) to prevent bulk-import storm, LibrarySyncHandler respects AutoSyncOnItemAdded toggle, SanitizeThemeName handles Windows reserved names, all File.Delete calls wrapped in try/catch, temp file cleanup in finally. Breaking changes: none.

v2.5.13.0: Real-time theme sync on new library items via LibrarySyncHandler that subscribes to ILibraryManager.ItemAdded; 30s debounce batching for bulk imports. New MissingThemeFallbackMode config option (None/AllOPs/AllEDs/AllVideos/AllOPsEDsVideos) controls what to download when an item has zero existing themes. Fallback mode added to config page Themes tab. Italian/English translations included. Breaking changes: none.

v2.5.12.3: Hotfix for global OP/ED + video replacement on items that only resolve through title fallback. Title fallback now retries trusted Jellyfin titles including OriginalTitle, TvdbSlug, and AnimeClick slug, hydrates the selected AnimeThemes result before download, and uses a new cache key to bypass stale negative title-cache entries. This allows legacy muted __0.webm files to be replaced with audible __50.webm files for romanized/English-title mismatches. Breaking changes: none.

v2.5.12.2: Hotfix for global preset sync robustness. Handles AnimeThemes responses with missing animethemes/entries/videos/audio without ArgumentNullException, so items with no usable themes are skipped cleanly while the OP/ED + video replacement run continues. Breaking changes: none.

v2.5.12.1: Hotfix for the Jellyfin main-menu Item Themes page. Adds the global quick actions (Scarica tutti OP, Scarica tutti ED, Scarica OP/ED, Scarica OP/ED + video) and live sync progress to KometaThemesItem, bumps the cache-busting Theme Finder page name/version, and keeps the 2.5.12 audible-video replacement behavior. Breaking changes: none.

v2.5.12: Fix Theme Finder button injection so it only appears on visible Series and Movie detail pages, never Season/Episode pages. Video downloads now default to audible 50% volume, migrate old muted defaults once, write WebM files as __50.webm, and replace legacy muted __0.webm files. Adds elevated preset sync actions for all OP audio, all ED audio, all OP/ED audio, and all OP/ED audio plus video. Breaking changes: none.
v2.5.11: 6-tab settings UI with configurable library pattern, sync interval, dry-run mode, ffmpeg timeout, and excluded items dashboard. New Skipped Items REST API.

v2.5.10: Hotfix for Theme Finder. Detail-page button now survives Jellyfin SPA back/forward and item navigation. MP3/WebM selected and downloaded states are clearer. Download selected now binds selected theme payloads correctly instead of returning No themes specified. Queue logs include MP3/WebM labels.

v2.5.9.1: Fix Theme Finder media selection not entering the download payload by using stable index/type selection keys and storing queued URL metadata at click time. Makes unselected MP3/WebM and bulk buttons visibly subdued, adds selected counts to the download button, makes All MP3/WebM true toggles, disables unavailable bulk actions, and logs queued items before manual download starts. Breaking changes: none.

v2.5.9: Force Theme Finder refresh in Jellyfin Web by registering a versioned page name, navigating with cache-busting query parameters, and serving the item-button script with no-cache headers. Keeps the 2.5.8 full UI rewrite and fixes stale UI/button behavior after reinstall.

v2.5.8: Full Theme Finder UI rewrite with Jellyfin-native three-column desktop layout, single-column mobile layout, compact search results, one unified action bar, a single OP/ED list without season accordions, segmented MP3/WebM toggles, disabled downloaded media controls, and collapsible download log. Removes duplicated global/per-season/download-all buttons. Breaking changes: none.

v2.5.7: Fix Theme Finder manual selection state with stable JS selection keys, visible selected/partial states for individual and bulk OP/ED buttons, persistent selected counter, compact reordered details/download layout, and stronger backend payload binding/logging for manual downloads. Breaking changes: none.
v2.5.6.3: Critical fix — broken bulk OP/ED selection in season-grouped view due to JSON round-trip object identity. Added themeIndexMap for correct theme lookup.

v2.5.6.2: Unmissable selection state with filled accent color + checkmark + glow shadow, toast notifications for all bulk actions (count feedback), new Download All button, and download confirmation toast.
v2.5.6.1: Design polish with hover/active states, focus-visible rings, smooth transitions, theme-tinted shadows, refined typography (letter-spacing, text-wrap), and light-theme accent tweak.

v2.5.6: Season-grouped theme picker with collapsible accordion UI, per-season OP/ED bulk download buttons, global multi-season 'All OP/ED MP3/WebM' action bar, parallel manual downloads (2x), and download progress counter.

v2.5.5: Fix Theme Finder detail loading by using the AnimeThemes slug show endpoint when available, resolving cases where the ID-filtered endpoint returns empty theme lists. Adds poster-card search results and richer OP/ED media rows, preserves OP1/ED1 labels when AnimeThemes sequence is null, and retries automatic non-Latin original-title searches with the Jellyfin display name. Breaking changes: none.

v2.5.4: Theme Finder search quality fix. Adds item-aware trusted title/slug matching, confidence labels, strict filtering of broad AnimeThemes search results, broad-results manual rescue, and diagnostic candidate logging.

v2.5.3: Redesigned Theme Finder as a contextual Jellyfin item screen with metadata, visible DIR/FILE paths, copy controls, automatic search, clearer result/detail panels, and plugin-wide UI language setting (English default, Italian secondary).

v2.5.2: Theme Finder refresh with IT/EN labels, clearer item/result/selected-anime states, synopsis and improved OP/ED rows. Hardened manual downloads with item/media/URL validation, HTTPS animethemes.moe allow-listing, sanitized filenames, path traversal protection, deduped theme rows and consistent JSON errors.
v2.5.1: injector v4 — button recreated on every hash change. Fixes disappearing button and stale item IDs between detail pages.
v2.5.0: MutationObserver injector (stable button). Info card with synopsis. Clean title + year filter. Loading spinner. Alt search. Error messages.
v2.3.2: Fix search undefined. Info card with item details. Clean title pre-fill. Year filter. Loading spinner. Alt search buttons. Synopsis display. Better errors.
v2.3.1: Fix search 422 (remove include from search). Fix anime by ID endpoint (/anime/?filter[id]=xxx).
v2.3.0: Theme Finder — manual OP/ED search & download. Music note button on detail pages. Select audio/video per theme. Select All / Download Selected. Already-downloaded detection.
v2.2.0: Hardcoded Anime-only (no lib regex). Live sync progress bar. DegreeOfParallelism slider. Item page in menu. Compiled regex. GUID normalize. Item button JS endpoint.

v2.1.0: Anime-only libraries. Fixes: DownloadTracker race, ffmpeg orphans, ForceSync restore, SemaphoreSlim leak, timer swallows, regex crash, API batch pagination, itemPage delete. New: SyncStatusTracker live progress, SeasonDetectionMode wired, MaxThemesPerSeason enforced, AniListClient registered, CDN resilience.

v2.0.3: Fix ArgumentNullException on virtual items (null ContainingFolderPath). Fix title search crash (clean codec tags, handle 422). Force Sync button uses task GUID. IsSatisfied uses MovieSettings.

v2.0.2: Fix title search crash (clean codec tags, handle 422). Force Sync button uses task GUID (fixes 404). IsSatisfied uses MovieSettings. SkippedItems filtered. AllPerSeason removed from movie selects.

v2.0.1: Fix Force Sync 404 on Jellyfin 10.11.x (use task GUID lookup). IsSatisfied uses MovieSettings. SkippedItems filtered. AllPerSeason removed from movie selects. ForceSync button prominent + truly forces.

v2.0.0: Multi-season/AllPerSeason, AniList, Skip/Ignore, per-item Sync API, M3U playlist. Hotfix: IsSatisfied now uses MovieSettings for movies, SkippedItems filtered in resolver, AllPerSeason removed from movie selects, ForceSync button truly forces.
v1.1.2: Fixed mapping save error, search scope bug, injector loads from GitHub raw.
